cases.false_claim: Setting extra C1 fields to zero automatically yields pure Einstein-Maxwell even with interactions retained
cases.source: C1 potential contains g_EM R X
cases.meaning: Restricted action retains nonminimal curvature-electromagnetism coupling, so unconditional equality is false.
cases.scope: Off-shell polynomial witness, not a physical Einstein spacetime solution

cases.false_claim: SM gauge-only branch with H=0 has exactly Maxwell L=-X/4
cases.meaning: At H=0, V0=lambda*v^4/4 survives and contributes to gravity if coupled.
cases.scope: Classical fixed-background density; H=0 generally unstable; no quantum SM correspondence

cases.false_claim: Every nonzero kappa I is unobservable under all measurements
cases.source: Geometry source_absorption is conditional on free matter reallocation and source-only observer
cases.meaning: Independent matter knowledge can distinguish nonzero kappa term; no general physical no-go proved.
cases.scope: Finite component example, not a physical observation
